$Comment: The Ice King's crown, dropped on death (Drop_AT_Ice_King). Its Model is Crown_Item.blockymodel: a copy of the king's own Head attachment (Common/NPC/AdventureTime/Ice_King/Models/Attachments/Head.*, same texture) plus a gold lid (Crown-Lid) 4.5 units over the crown base, because a player's hair showed through the open top. After editing Head.blockymodel, rebuild the copy: python scripts/crown-lid.py <Attachments>/Head.blockymodel <Attachments>/Crown_Item.blockymodel 4.5. The king's skeleton has the player rig (Parent Player), so the piece fits a player head. Fields copied from vanilla Armor_Iron_Head without its Recipe (loot only). Icon: Icons/ItemsGenerated/AT_Ice_King/AT_Ice_King_Crown.png, rendered from that Head model with the Mob Battle ModelThumbnail renderer (scratchpad tools/icon64.py: crop, 58 px, 64x64 canvas). Gives 100 ice magic (stat AT_Ice_Magic) for the ice runes.
